verdict.rationale: incident.io explicitly markets 'public and private Status Pages' and pricing docs mention 'Private incidents and policies,' confirming a private status page capability exists alongside public ones. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on the specific access-control mechanisms (e.g., SSO/SAML gating, customer-specific vs employee-only audience segmentation) needed to fully confirm granular audience control. Missing for 10: documentation of authentication/access-control methods for private status pages, and evidence of distinct audience segmentation (customer vs internal-only pages).
